test_cases.name: happy_path_threshold_triggered_eviction
test_cases.description: Full lifecycle execution where context utilization exceeds high watermark threshold, triggering LRU eviction down to target low watermark capacity and inserting semantic stub pointers.
test_cases.input: Ingest context reaching 85000 tokens in a 100000 capacity window with high_watermark_ratio 0.80 and low_watermark_ratio 0.60.

test_cases.name: dependency_preservation_skips_prerequisite
test_cases.description: Evaluates dependency graph preservation ensuring the lowest-recency block is protected from eviction when an active uncompleted task declares it as a dependent.
test_cases.input: Trigger pruning when oldest block ctx-02 is listed in dependent_block_ids of active block ctx-04.

test_cases.name: pinned_block_immunity
test_cases.description: Verifies that system prompt and pinned memory blocks are immune from eviction regardless of age or recency order.
test_cases.input: Execute pruning on working context where oldest block ctx-01 has is_pinned set to true.

test_cases.name: context_under_threshold_stable
test_cases.description: Verifies that context utilization below the high watermark ratio maintains active context without triggering candidate selection or eviction.
test_cases.input: Evaluate context footprint at 55000 tokens in a 100000 capacity window with high_watermark_ratio 0.80.

test_cases.name: insufficient_headroom_defect_halt
test_cases.description: Fails fast and emits PRUNING_TARGET_UNREACHABLE defect report when all unpruned blocks are pinned or locked by dependencies, preventing attainment of low watermark.
test_cases.input: Execute pruning when context is 88000 tokens in a 100000 capacity window and all candidate blocks are either pinned or active dependencies.
